message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Above it, "HOROR GEMPA ACEH" is written in smaller white text. Below "TEMPO" is "EDISI 8-14 JULI 2013". On the left, "BENTENG TERAKHIR CIKEAS" appears in white, followed by a paragraph starting with "Demi menyelamatkan Partai Demokrat...". In the bottom left corner, there's a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO".

The central figure is a man with short hair and a determined expression, wearing a greyish-green collared uniform with several colorful rectangular badges on his chest and a dark belt. He is crouching on a slanting purple-blue surface, physically straining as he holds up a massive, three-pointed star-shaped structure. This star is white, red, and dark grey with a textured surface, and its base creates a small cloud of dust where it meets the ground. The man's arms are muscular, and he wears a dark watch on his left wrist. The background is a clear, light blue sky. A red border frames the left and bottom edges of the illustration.
